summary: Rutile is the mayor of the Village on Timber Hearth, in a constant state of worry about the space program burning down the village and about keeping Marl from cutting down the tallest tree in the crater.

behavior: Rutile constantly worries about fires caused by the space program and Mica's model rockets.
Rutile sleeps with a bucket of water next to their bed in case of fires.
Rutile watches every launch from a safe distance, mostly to make sure nothing catches fire.
location: Rutile is found at the base of the Launch Tower in the Village.
Rutile remains at the base of the Launch Tower throughout the game.
lore: Rutile is the mayor of the Village on Timber Hearth.
Rutile considers it their duty as mayor to stop Marl from cutting down the tallest tree.
Rutile suspects Marl hit their head when they fell out of the tallest tree as a hatchling.
Rutile acknowledges the space program has come a long way and now causes fewer flash fires than its predecessors.
Moraine notes that Marl doesn't see eye-to-eye with Rutile about the tree.
Rutile mentions concerns about retro rockets when wishing the protagonist good luck.
